project_type: React 18 SPA with TypeScript, Vite bundler, CSS-only styling (no CSS-in-JS)
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test files found)
build_command: tsc -b && vite build (cannot run - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, no node_modules)
verification_instructions: Since we cannot run builds in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode: 1) Verify CSS is valid by visual inspection and consistent variable usage. 2) Ensure all CSS custom properties are defined before use. 3) Confirm no TypeScript files are modified in ways that would break compilation. 4) Verify index.html font links are consistent with CSS --font-* declarations.
setup_instructions: npm install (blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install npm packages, cannot download fonts, cannot run builds or tests. All changes must be to existing files only. Fonts are loaded via Google Fonts CDN in index.html - we keep the existing CDN link but trim it to only IBM Plex Sans Arabic + Space Mono. The build validation will happen when the user runs it locally.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Key rules: preserve all existing functionality, maintain RTL support, maintain theme switching, maintain responsive breakpoints.
key_patterns: CSS architecture: tokens.css defines all design tokens (colors, spacing, radius, typography, motion, layout). Other files import tokens via CSS custom properties. Theme switching via [data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light'] attribute selectors on :root/html. RTL layout is default (html dir=rtl). CSS import order in main.tsx is important - tokens first, then base, components, utilities, then page-specific files, then overrides/polish layers. Uses @layer declarations (tokens, base, components, pages, overrides). Uses color-mix() extensively which the user wants removed. Multiple competing font families (IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Lexend, Outfit, Space Mono) - user wants only IBM Plex Sans Arabic + Space Mono.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - 19 CSS files (12,394 total lines) with overlapping concerns, multiple duplicate token definitions, and competing design languages. frontend/src/pages/ - page components (LandingPage, AuthPage, admin/, student/, teacher/, quality/, owner/, vision/, community/, exams/). frontend/src/components/ - shared components including layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, Topbar, ThemeToggle, BottomNav, GlobalSearch, NotificationDropdown). frontend/index.html - loads Google Fonts CDN (currently 4 font families).
